posts.title: Teach yourself Finnish with Maustetytöt!
posts.description: There is now an epic and much-needed update to the English lyrics page for an essential, early song from my favorite band, Finland's Maustetytöt. Along with the lyrics to Muistot karkaa (Memories escape), find a fun and easy Finnish language lesson by the (equally essential) lilli m , who is behind this entire lyrics update.

posts.title: Journalism as a Trojan Horse for surveillance
posts.description: Two related stories in the past week: Shubham Bose shows how reading a story on the New York Times website involves downloading 49 megabytes and making 422 network requests to, as he describes it, "mine your data" and auction your attention to "dozens" of ad networks in a process "incredibly hostile" to the reader.
